headline: XP sees upside for Minerva Foods but notes cash flow hurdles
summary: XP Investimentos views Minerva Foods as having significant potential upside on the stock exchange, though the company continues to face challenges regarding cash flow generation and debt reduction ahead of its earnings report.
why: Analyst evaluations of debt leverage and cash conversion are critical for assessing the equity valuation of major meatpacking and agricultural exporters.
